description: Trafic annuel entrant par station de métro à Montreuil is a dataset listed in Montreuil Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by RATP. Ce jeu de données détaille le trafic des entrants directs sur le réseau ferré RATP en 2018 pour les stations montreuilloises. Coverage: Montreuil. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are transports. The portal shows 3 records. The portal shows 2019-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-montreuil-fr-portal.
